plan.title: Scholarship Application Summary
plan.subtitle: Overview of applicant demographics, status distribution, and financial eligibility

panels.title: Approved Applications
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM "scholarship_applicants" WHERE "Status" = 'Approved'

panels.title: Disbursed Applications
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM "scholarship_applicants" WHERE "Status" = 'Disbursed'

panels.title: Applications by Status
panels.sql: SELECT "Status", COUNT(*) AS count FROM "scholarship_applicants" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Applications by Category
panels.sql: SELECT "Category", COUNT(*) AS count FROM "scholarship_applicants" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Applications by District
panels.sql: SELECT "District", COUNT(*) AS count FROM "scholarship_applicants" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Top 5 Schemes by Volume
panels.sql: SELECT "Name of scheme", COUNT(*) AS count FROM "scholarship_applicants" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

plan.narrative: The board has received a total of {{p1}} scholarship applications. Of these, {{p2}} have been approved and {{p3}} have been disbursed. The majority of applications fall under the 'Approved' status, as shown in the status distribution. Category-wise, the highest volume of applications comes from the {{p5}} category. Geographically, the {{p6}} district leads in application volume. The most popular scheme among applicants is the {{p7}} scheme.
